style: soft polished storybook snack scenes for young Chinese learners

items.label: Ice cream preference dialogue
items.hanzi: 我喜欢吃冰淇淋。你喜欢吃什么？
items.pinyin: wǒ xǐ huan chī bīng qí lín. nǐ xǐ huan chī shén me?
items.theme: Anan is ready to eat ice cream while talking naturally with a friend at a simple kitchen table

items.label: Family food preferences
items.hanzi: 妈妈喜欢吃饺子。爸爸不喜欢吃饺子。
items.pinyin: mā ma xǐ huan chī jiǎo zi. bà ba bù xǐ huan chī jiǎo zi.
items.theme: Mom enjoys dumplings while Dad politely chooses another food at the family dining table
